_doc: Corrections to the decompilation, applied before translation (tools/translate.py). Each is a decompiler error proven against the instructions: 'from' must occur exactly once in the function's corpus text, and 'why' gives the instruction evidence.

141f09460.why: the connection map's erase frees the node it unlinked, not the bucket: the walk at 0x141f095c2..0x141f095d3 stops when rcx == [rsp + 0x30] (the iterator's node, plVar5 == local_1a8), and rcx goes unchanged to SMemFree at 0x141f095e5; Ghidra printed the bucket slot (plStack_1a0, [rsp + 0x38]). Freeing a slot inside the bucket array corrupted the heap, and the Battle.net shutdown died in the manager's destructor (0xC0000374 on quit)

141f01560.why: the MethodInfo map copy rehashes to the source's bucket count: rdx = [r12 + 0x30] (r12 = param_2) at 0x141f01585, rcx = r13 + 0x30 at 0x141f0158a, call at 0x141f015ac; the stores between go to the copy (r13), so callargs could not show the load unchanged

140666bd0.why: the grown string copies its old text with the terminator: r8 = [rdi + 8] + 1 (rdi = param_1) at 0x140666cd8..0x140666cdf, rdx = [rdi] at 0x140666ce5, memmove at 0x140666ceb

141f2ece0.why: cross_ssl's start calls the factory's Initialize (vtable 0x142880130 slot 1, 0x141f6fcf0, which reads a logger third) with the logger it just made: r8 = rax from the allocation at 0x141f2ee01 (r14 = 0 when it failed, 0x141f2ee1c), stored to DAT_143264fb0 at 0x141f2ee91, call at 0x141f2ee98. Without it the SChannel setup logged through a garbage pointer and faulted, ssl::Initialize freed the filter map, and GlueLogin read the null map

1420bdde0.why: mp_init_size(a, n): rcx is param_1 from entry to the call at 0x1420bde48 (copied to rbx at 0x1420bde22, never changed); Ghidra printed the argument as 0

1414cfc40.why: the Aurora back interface setup takes the object: rcx is param_1 from entry (the fields are zeroed through it at 0x1414cfc4a..0x1414cfc6e) to the call at 0x1414cfc72

1414d0dd0.why: the old member goes in rdx: mov rdx,[rbp+8] at 0x1414d0e2b, rcx = rdi (param_1 + 1) at 0x1414d0e3b, call at 0x1414d0e3e
the old member goes in rdx: mov rdx,[rbp+0x18] at 0x1414d0e65, call at 0x1414d0e78
the old member goes in rdx: mov rdx,[rbp+0x28] at 0x1414d0e9f, call at 0x1414d0eb3
the old member goes in rdx: mov rdx,[rbp+0x38] at 0x1414d0eb8, call at 0x1414d0ec9
the old member goes in rdx: mov rdx,[rbp+0x40] at 0x1414d0ece, call at 0x1414d0edf

141f6fcf0.why: in_RAX is only the error path's return; see below
the error callback's result is discarded: xor al,al at 0x141f6fd34 follows the call at 0x141f6fd31
the already-initialized path returns false: xor al,al at 0x141f6fd34, then ret at 0x141f6fd40 (callers test al)

141c5ce70.why: a unique_ptr reset hands its deleter the old pointer: rdx = [0x14323b2b0] at 0x141c5d022, read before the new one is stored at 0x141c5d029, rcx = &DAT_14323b2b0 at 0x141c5d035, call at 0x141c5d03c (FUN_141c5cc20 frees param_2). lVar4 is free here: every later use reassigns it first

1414cafb0.why: the map copy rehashes to the source's bucket count: rdx = [r12] at 0x1414cb13a (r12 = param_1 + 0x20, 0x1414cb123..0x1414cb12b), the same register stored to local_60 ([rbp-1]) at 0x1414cb14f, rcx = &local_60 at 0x1414cb127, call at 0x1414cb157

14147f390.why: the export leaves DAT_1430af3f8 untyped; the load is 8 bytes: mov rax,[rip->0x1430af3f8] at 0x14147f390, then mov rax,[rax] at 0x14147f397
